rules.topic: Scope limits - keep to pilot use case
rules.position: Keep the agreement scoped to candidate-material summaries and interview-note drafting for human review; any expansion requires a separate written approval, security review, and scoped order form.
rules.quote: should require a separate written approval, security review, and scoped order form.

rules.position: TalentFlow will not make autonomous hire, reject, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking, filtering, or scoring decisions - all outputs are for human review only.
rules.quote: it will not make autonomous hire, reject, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking,

rules.position: AgentCo preserves ownership of its platform, models, reusable workflows, prompt templates, evaluation methods, and non-customer-specific know-how.
rules.quote: AgentCo should preserve ownership of its platform, models, reusable

rules.topic: Customer ownership of candidate data and outputs
rules.position: LargeCo owns its candidate materials, job requirements, prompts, configurations, and customer-specific outputs.
rules.quote: agree that LargeCo owns its candidate materials, job requirements, prompts,

rules.topic: No training / no sale of candidate data
rules.position: AgentCo will not sell, share, train on, or use candidate data outside TalentFlow.
rules.quote: AgentCo should not sell, share, train on, or use candidate data outside TalentFlow.

rules.topic: Outputs are drafts, not guaranteed decisions
rules.position: TalentFlow outputs are drafts for human review, not guaranteed legal, compliant, unbiased, or complete hiring decisions.
rules.quote: TalentFlow outputs should be treated as drafts for human review, not guaranteed legal, compliant, unbiased, or complete hiring decisions.

rules.topic: Security/audit - resist unrestricted access and rigid uptime/response terms
rules.position: Resist unrestricted code access, monthly scans, uncontrolled testing, 99.99% uptime, thirty-minute resolution obligations, and automatic 100% service credits.
rules.fallback: Offer a standard SaaS SLA with severity-based support and limited service credits.
rules.quote: It should resist unrestricted code access, monthly scans, uncontrolled testing, 99.99% uptime, thirty-minute resolution obligations, and automatic 100% service credits.

rules.position: Offer a standard SaaS SLA with severity-based support and limited service credits rather than bespoke uptime/response commitments.
rules.quote: Offer a standard SaaS SLA with severity-based support and limited service credits.

rules.topic: Liability cap - baseline plus targeted higher cap
rules.position: Protect the baseline liability cap at fees paid in the prior twelve months, while considering a targeted higher cap for confidentiality, candidate-data security, and DPA breaches.
rules.fallback: A targeted higher cap (e.g., a multiple of fees) for confidentiality, candidate-data security, and DPA breach claims only.
rules.quote: AgentCo should protect the  baseline cap at fees paid in the prior twelve months, while considering a targeted higher cap for conﬁdentiality, candidate-data security, and DPA breaches.

rules.topic: Resist unlimited liability for AI output and hiring-decision issues
rules.position: Resist unlimited liability for AI output issues, customer hiring decisions, unreviewed use of outputs, LargeCo's job criteria, candidate notices, workflows, or employment decisions.
rules.quote: It should resist unlimited liability for AI output issues, customer hiring decisions, unreviewed use of outputs, LargeCo’s job criteria, candidate notices, workﬂows, or employment decisions.

rules.position: IP indemnity should stay tied to the AgentCo service and standard exclusions.
rules.quote: IP indemnity should stay tied to the AgentCo service and standard exclusions.

rules.position: AgentCo can accept a DPA, confidentiality protections, no-training commitments, limits on use of candidate data, commercially reasonable security obligations, subprocessor notice, data export/deletion, audit logs, admin controls, and documentation describing intended use and human-review expectations.
rules.quote: limits on use of candidate data, commercially reasonable security obligations, subprocessor notice, data export/deletion, audit logs, admin controls,

rules.position: AgentCo can provide SOC 2 or equivalent materials, questionnaires, subprocessor details, data-flow descriptions, and a reasonable annual audit process.
rules.quote: questionnaires, subprocessor details, data-ﬂow descriptions, and a reasonable annual audit process.

rules.topic: No expansion into ATS/scoring/background checks/payroll etc without approval
rules.position: Any expansion into ATS integrations, candidate scoring, assessments, background checks, payroll, benefits, immigration, accommodations, or employee-relations data should require a separate written approval, security review, and scoped order form.
